info.title: estadistica
info.description: Cifras REM del establecimiento junto al promedio nacional y de pares, y el avance de las Metas Sanitarias

get.summary: Every fuente this install holds: REM Serie A and P, year by year, and the establishments. Each says where it comes from (origen: datos públicos DEIS), up to when (fecha_corte: YYYY-MM for REM), how many rows it holds, and whether it is whole (estado: ok, incompleto, sin datos). A REM year also says how many of its códigos no dictionary explains (sin_descripcion) and whose dictionary labels it (etiquetas_de).

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The fuentes, REM Serie A, REM Serie P, then the establishments

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: One fuente, with its catálogo. For rem-a and rem-p, one year's hojas, secciones, prestaciones (código and label) and columns (col01…col50 and label), from that year's DICCIONARIO CODIGOS or, for a year without one, from the nearest later year's (etiquetas_de). For establecimientos, the values a peer group is chosen from, each with how many establishments carry it.
get.description: An anio outside 2009 to the current year cannot be a REM year, and is refused rather than answered with an empty catálogo (epi's blank lesson: an empty answer is only for a question that was understood).

parameters.name: anio
parameters.description: for REM, the year whose catálogo to read; the newest loaded year when omitted

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The year cannot be a REM year — {message: the Spanish sentence}

post.summary: Answers one consulta: the local establishment's series and, when the spec asks to compare, the national and the peer group's. Each is summed and grouped as the spec says, and comes with the labels of what was summed and the fuente it came from. The builder asks through here, so the API returns the UI's numbers (a15).
post.description:
The spec is refused in Spanish, before any SQL, when it names anything it may not: an unknown key, a column outside col01…col50, a metric that is not suma or promedio_establecimiento (a16). A consulta that runs past 10 s is cancelled and refused the same way.
The local series is this install's establishment (app config), unless the request names another DEIS code: a parameter, not an implicit «ours» (gestion ADR-0013). The app's own pages never send one, because a clinic selector is a governance decision nobody has taken.
It is a POST because the spec is a JSON document, and it spends the read limit because it writes nothing.

consulta.description: the spec: fuente, periodo, filtros, agrupar, metrica and comparar (docs/adr/0006)

establecimiento.description: the six-digit DEIS code of the local series; this install's when omitted

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The series (null where not asked for, or no establishment is configured), their labels and their fuente

422.description: Understood and refused — {message: the Spanish sentence}

tags.name: admin
tags.description: The admin section's actions: its writes, and the ingest state it reads. Every public method carries #[AuthorizedAdminSetting(settings: AdminSettings::class)] and nothing else that decides who may call it: NC core lets a real admin through, lets a member of any group an admin delegated the section to through, and answers 403 to everyone else (SecurityMiddleware). A hand-written admin check beside it would refuse every delegate — IntraVox's SettingsApiController does exactly that — so there is none, and MetadataTest fails a method without the attribute (docs/adr/0003). The check's name is not even written here: the a10 gate greps this directory for it. CSRF stays on: the section's own requests carry the token, and an API client sends OCS-APIRequest: true, which NC accepts in its place.

tags.name: api
tags.description: Estadística over OCS: the contract suite apps and M3 read (gestion docs/CONTRACTS.md, Slice 10). farmacia's resource-per-endpoint shape (the OCS decision), under Spanish resource names: fuentes and consultas. Consumers send `OCS-APIRequest: true`, which is also the CSRF protection (Request::passesCSRFCheck), and get the OCS envelope back: GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/estadistica/api/v1/fuentes { "ocs": { "meta": {…}, "data": [ …the fuentes… ] } } Everyone reads everything published (D6), so every route is #[NoAdminRequired], and every one carries a #[UserRateLimit] (MetadataTest holds both).
